note: BDO's ATM Savings, the everyday account there: a required monthly average daily balance of 2,000 pesos, and a 300-peso fee once the account falls below it for two consecutive months (the game charges it for any month below, not counting the first month's grace). Read again 2026-10-30: opens with 2,000 pesos and one valid ID; pays 0.0625% a year gross (20% withheld) once the balance is 5,000 pesos (written as interest over 5,000). Not stated on this page: overdraft, ATM fees, transfers.

sources.title: BDO Unibank, ATM Savings
sources.said: Minimum MADB Requirement (1) ₱ 2,000 ... Falling Below Minimum Balance (3) ₱300 ... (3) Falling Below Minimum Balance Fee will be collected if account falls below the required minimum MADB for two consecutive months.
